bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches single light pool, hard edged beam, performer isolation, black void, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/stage-spotlight/generated-lead.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
